description: Codex case 3 (a false FAIL on the commit that made lexical scope exact): `namespace assert { … }` at the top level (an expression statement holding an internal module) declares `assert` again, so `assert.equal` is the namespace's function, not node:assert's. Removing it is a WARN (the call may not have asserted), never FAIL; the real runner runs the test on both sides.
